acip: 'DIS SEMS CAN RNAMS DNGOS PO JI LTAR GNAS PA'I RANG BZHIN LTA BA LA SGRIB PA STE RMONGS PAR BYED PA'I PHYIR NA GTI MUG STE, MA RIG PA DNGOS PO'I NGO BO RANG BZHIN GYIS YOD PA MA YIN PA LA, RANG BZHIN GYIS YOD PAR SGRO 'DOGS PAR BYED PA YIN LUGS KYI RANG BZHIN MTHONG BA LA SGRIB PA'I BDAG NYID CAN NI KUN RDZOB BO,,
wylie: 'dis sems can rnams dngos po ji ltar gnas pa'i rang bzhin lta ba la sgrib pa ste rmongs par byed pa'i phyir na gti mug ste, ma rig pa dngos po'i ngo bo rang bzhin gyis yod pa ma yin pa la, rang bzhin gyis yod par sgro 'dogs par byed pa yin lugs kyi rang bzhin mthong ba la sgrib pa'i bdag nyid can ni kun rdzob bo
english: Dark ignorance is given its name from the fact that it leaves living beings in the dark: it draws a veil over our ability to see how things really exist—their nature. Misunderstanding enables us to see things as more than they actually are: it makes us believe that the essential nature of things—which is anything but these things' existing through some nature of their own—is for them to exist through just such a nature. “Deception” then is that entity whose nature is to veil our ability to see the true nature of things: the way they truly are.
